text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
That takes care of submitting the paperwork.
Good work.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hey, looks like an old sheet got mixed in.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Ah, my apologies.
Or rather, there are an awful lot of corrections—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, what do you know.
This is from "back then."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove, allow me to introduce her.
Joining the student council as our second Vice President,
this is Narita Brian.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Tch...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Biwa Hayahide's sister, I see. Clicking your tongue
upon our first meeting—quite the greeting.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, you two.
You are comrades who will walk forward together from here on.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
With our prodigies assembled, the student council is complete.
Together with these members, let us elevate the academy.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian!
What on earth is this paperwork?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
The suggestion box summary, right?
Is there a problem?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Do not divide the suggestions by
whether you like them or not
instead of whether they are feasible!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Well, I was actually planning on reviewing
the suggestion box submissions myself.
Why don't we all go over them together once more?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian!
Where did she disappear to?! The meeting's about to start!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, classes just ended, so perhaps she went out for a run...
...I'll go look for her.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Grrrrrgh...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Not just once, but twice now!
What is the meaning of failing to show up to our regular meetings?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Please answer me, President.
Why did you bring someone like that into the council?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Simply put, because her talent is indispensable.
Until she grows accustomed to how we do things here, I will provide follow-up.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
So please, allow her to take part in the student council...
No, I am certain the day will come when even you recognize her worth.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Even so, no matter how bright someone's talent might shine, in the student council—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
A hidden dragon, a fledgling phoenix—
I know I am being selfish, but won't you watch over her for just a little while longer?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The President may have said that, but... dammit,
am I really supposed to just endure this situation...?!

text_block_list.name: Student Council Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
The Vice President has been cleaning non-stop...
There's nowhere left to polish though—the floor and tables are all like mirrors...

text_block_list.name: Student Council Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text: She even took apart the air conditioner to clean the inside... For now, let's just leave her alone...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I ended up cleaning every single nook and cranny of the student council room...
Before I knew it, it was almost lights out.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Back then, I wondered what would become of us, but... heheh.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: You sure remember every little detail, don't you...

Walking down the hallway, I overheard their conversation.
It seems the start of the student council was quite tumultuous...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: The President smoothed things over, but looking back, you have been a handful ever since day one.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Stop sounding like my big sister, sheesh.

Walking down the hallway, I overheard their conversation.
It seems the start of the student council was quite tumultuous...
